page.layout: Running head at top centre: "DE GRATITVDINE." with page number 167 at top right. Main text in two parallel columns: left column (wider Latin text) and right column (narrower, Exodus-quoted text continues). Below the first block, a full-width passage. Right-hand column carries marginal references "d" and "e" with cross-reference notes beside the text. Full-width headings "Tertium praeceptum." and "Quartum praeceptum." between blocks. Signature "L 5" at foot.

main_text.p: idque in tertia & quarta progenie eorum qui oderunt me: & misericordia utens in millemillesimam eorum, qui diligunt me, & observant praecepta meac, minus Deus tuus Deus zelotes, visitans iniquitatem patrum super filios, in tertiam & quartam generationem, odio habentibus me: Et faciens misericordiam millibus diligentibus me & custodientibus praecepta mea.
main_text.head: Tertium praeceptum.
main_text.p: Ne usurpes nomen Domini Dei tui temere. Neque enim Dominus dimittet eum impunitum, qui nomen eius vane usurpaveritd Exod. 20. v. 7. Non assumes nomen Domini Dei tui in vanum: quia non insontem habebit Dominus eum, qui assumpserit nomen eius in vanum..
Deut. 5. v. 11. Non assumes nomen Domini Dei tui in vanum: non enim Dominus insontem habebit eum, qui acceperit nomen eius in vanum.
main_text.head: Quartum praeceptum.

page.notes: Marginal reference letters c, d, e in the right column; Latin text partly set in italic and in roman; some words uncertain in the scan (e.g. "millemillesimam" reading is doubtful and should be checked against the printed "millibus"). Several line-end words in the right column are uncertain and marked by reconstruction.
